# Pull Request

## Description
Brief description of changes

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring/code improvement

## Changes Made
- [ ] List specific changes
- [ ] Include any configuration changes
- [ ] Mention new dependencies

## Testing
- [ ] Tested locally with various configurations
- [ ] Added/updated tests if applicable
- [ ] Verified CLI functionality
- [ ] Tested pre-commit integration

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] Self-review of the code has been performed
- [ ] Code is commented, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] Documentation has been updated if needed
- [ ] Tests pass locally
- [ ] Any new dependencies are justified and documented

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number)

## Additional Notes
Any additional information, screenshots, or context that would be helpful for reviewers.
